chunks: Zurarah ibn A'yan said to Abu Ja'far al-Baqir عليه السلام:
Inform me about the limit of the face which should be washed in wudu (ablution), the one Allah, Mighty and Majestic, mentioned.

So he said: The face that Allah mentioned and that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded to be washed is that to which no one should add and from which no one should subtract. If he adds to it, he will not be rewarded, and if he subtracts from it, he sins. It is that over which the middle finger and the thumb pass, from the hairline of the head to the chin; and whatever the two fingers encompass in a circular manner is of the face, and whatever is beyond that is not of the face.
He said to him: Is the temple part of the face? He said: No.

Zurarah said: I said to him: What do you think about that which is surrounded by hair? He said: Everything surrounded by hair is not upon the servants to seek out or investigate, but water is to be made to flow over it.

key_terms.أَحَاطَ بِهِ الشَّعْرُ: what is covered or enclosed by hair
key_terms.الذَّقَنِ: the chin as the lower limit of the face
key_terms.الصُّدْغُ: the temple area at the side of the face
key_terms.بِغَسْلِهِ: its washing as a divine command
key_terms.حَدِّ الْوَجْهِ: the legal boundary of the face in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.قُصَاصِ شَعْرِ الرَّأْسِ: the hairline at the front of the head
key_terms.يُجْرَى عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءُ: water should be made to flow over it
key_terms.يُوَضَّأَ: to be washed as part of wudu (ablution)

ai.seo_question: What are the exact limits of the face that must be washed in wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith defines the legal boundaries of the face in wudu (ablution) and stresses precise compliance with the divinely required limit. It explains that the face extends from the hairline to the chin and across the area enclosed by the fingers, while areas covered by hair are not to be searched into, though water should pass over them.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.88 – Zurarah bin A'yan said to Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as):
"Inform me about the limits of the face that one should wash, as mentioned by Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic."
Imam (as) said: "The face that Allah (swt) has commanded to be washed is that which no one should add to or subtract from. If someone adds to it, they will not be rewarded, and if they subtract from it, they will sin. The area includes from the hairline of the head to the chin, and what is encompassed by the thumbs (when making a circle with the fingers) is considered part of the face. Anything outside of that is not considered part of the face”.
Zurarah asked: "What about the temples?"
Imam (as) said: "No."
Zurarah then said: "What if it is surrounded by hair?"
Imam (as) said: "Whatever is surrounded by hair is not required for the servants to seek or look for; however, water should flow over it."
